issue_context.title: juniper junos_facts does not gather junos_interfaces facts using gather_network_resources: interfaces
issue_context.body:
##### SUMMARY
juniper junos_facts does not gather junos_interfaces facts using gather_network_resources: interfaces, this works for ios_facts and eos_facts and should match for junos_facts, basically this does not work->
```
- name: grab juniper junos info
  junos_facts:
    gather_subset: min
    gather_network_resources: interfaces
```

my inventory
```
[juniper]
rtr3 ansible_host=3.15.5.167 private_ip=172.16.25.197

[juniper:vars]
ansible_user=ec2-user
ansible_network_os=junos
ansible_connection=netconf
```

no interfaces information is gathered

##### ISSUE TYPE
- Bug Report

##### COMPONENT NAME
junos_facts

<!--- Paste verbatim output from "ansible --version" between quotes -->
